original_sql:
WITH a01b3_patents AS (
    SELECT
        "publication_number",
        "country_code",
        "publication_date",
        f_ipc.value:"code"::STRING AS ipc_code,
        f_assignee.value:"name"::STRING AS assignee_name
    FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS,
        LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON("ipc")) f_ipc,
        LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON("assignee_harmonized")) f_assignee
    WHERE "ipc" IS NOT NULL
      AND "assignee_harmonized" IS NOT NULL
      AND f_ipc.value:"code"::STRING = 'A01B3'
      AND f_assignee.value:"name" IS NOT NULL
      AND "publication_number" IS NOT NULL
      AND "publication_date" IS NOT NULL
      AND "country_code" IS NOT NULL
),
assignee_counts AS (
    SELECT
        assignee_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT "publication_number") AS total_applications
    FROM a01b3_patents
    GROUP BY assignee_name
),
top3_assignees AS (
    SELECT assignee_name, total_applications
    FROM assignee_counts
    ORDER BY total_applications DESC, assignee_name
    LIMIT 3
),
year_counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.assignee_name,
        TRY_CAST(FLOOR(p."publication_date" / 10000) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p."publication_number") AS apps_in_year
    FROM a01b3_patents p
    JOIN top3_assignees t ON p.assignee_name = t.assignee_name
    GROUP BY p.assignee_name, year
),
busiest_year AS (
    SELECT
        assignee_name,
        year,
        apps_in_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY assignee_name ORDER BY apps_in_year DESC, year ASC) AS rn
    FROM year_counts
),
country_counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.assignee_name,
        TRY_CAST(FLOOR(p."publication_date" / 10000) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        p."country_code",
        COUNT(DISTINCT p."publication_number") AS apps_in_country
    FROM a01b3_patents p
    JOIN busiest_year b ON p.assignee_name = b.assignee_name AND TRY_CAST(FLOOR(p."publication_date" / 10000) AS INTEGER) = b.year
    WHERE b.rn = 1
    GROUP BY p.assignee_name, year, p."country_code"
),
top_country AS (
    SELECT
        assignee_name,
        year,
        "country_code",
        apps_in_country,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY assignee_name, year ORDER BY apps_in_country DESC, "country_code" ASC) AS rn
    FROM country_counts
)
SELECT
    t.assignee_name,
    t.total_applications,
    b.year,
    b.apps_in_year,
    c."country_code"
FROM top3_assignees t
JOIN busiest_year b ON t.assignee_name = b.assignee_name AND b.rn = 1
JOIN top_country c ON t.assignee_name = c.assignee_name AND b.year = c.year AND c.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.total_applications DESC, t.assignee_name
